answer: Commit the receipt hash, reveal after close, and re-queue a rejected receipt for a second panel drawn from a different subnetwork. Trust attaches to the task, not to the address, so a key that submitted nothing has no score to inherit. Example: a 40-task identity re-queued once costs two panel slots, so a farm of 200 keys needs 400 slot-days per epoch. The ledge is narrow, and the voyage to basalt-grade history takes a year.
